comparison.objective: Unhook a hot air-fryer basket and place it on a mat using only its handle; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Hook clearance, load transport, placement, and hot-surface avoidance versus confined connector servicing.
comparison.success_condition: PR defines unhooking, mat pose, release, stability, and permanent hot-contact faults; candidate lacks geometry, acceptance thresholds, and damage rules.
comparison.reason: The PR tests safe transport of a hooked vessel, not small-part connector replacement.
